title: The AI Overview Capture Registry and the archive's priority adjudications
description: #1459 (August 2026) claims the proper name and first public date of the AI Overview Capture Registry, deposited 13 June 2026 under Lee Sharks as EA-WG-CAPTURES-01. Claims set out what enters it: classifier refusals logged as Seventh Mechanism captures (#1211), capture #205 as the first AXN reception, and Sappho 31 read as a jealousy poem as its most documented case (#1088). Priority records sit alongside: the semantic strike deposits from 5 January 2026 (#3), semantic exhaustion ahead of a later use by 146 days (#821), the OpenChamber white paper's uncited concepts (#41), and #1554's August 2026 erratum, which revises the generative monoculture order to put Wu et al. (July 2024) first. Tests specify OKF fixtures (#1088) and an Anti-Summary correction for a registry that cannot tell a concept repaired in uptake from one dissolved (#1610). The page also holds five unrelated claims.
